title: Security Web UI: Surface OSV scanning in the web app
description: Add a Security dashboard and detail view to the Bahia SvelteKit web app so operators can view vulnerability scan results, trigger manual scans, inspect findings by severity, and monitor scan schedules — all backed by encrypted ContextVM methods and Nostr event subscriptions.
scope: Security Svelte store wired to ContextVM encrypted operations (security/scan, security/rescan, security/findings-list, security/schedules-list)
Dashboard route /security with severity summary, findings table, scan controls, and schedule list
Detail route /security/[id] showing scan run results with full findings
Unit tests for store operations and component rendering
User-guide documentation for the Security web UI
out_of_scope: Backend scanner changes — already implemented in SECURITY_OSV_SBOM
REST API endpoints — Security uses encrypted ContextVM only
MCP tool surface — explicitly out of scope per existing design
Policy configuration UI — uses existing /policies route

nostr_semantics.pattern: requestEncryptedResult for ContextVM calls; subscribe to NIP-38 status events for live scan progress
